main_text.p: אָשַׁם delinquens, יִם. delinquentes, &c. No. R. אָשַׁם reum fieri.
אָשִׂים, אָשְׂמָה ponam, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. parag. R. שׂוּם.
אַשְׁמְאִילָה sinistram petam, 1. f.fut. Hiph. parag. à No. שְׂמֹאל sinistra manus, m. R. שָׂמַל.
אַשְׁמָּו reatus suus, יו reatus sui, ם ipsorum, No. f. m. אַשְׁמָם aff. ut & pl. m. aff. R. אָשַׁם reum fieri.
אַשְׁמֵם, אַשְׁמֵם disponam ea, 1. f. fut. Hiph. aff. Rad. שׂוּם, vel שָׂמַם.
אַשְׁמָתֵנוּ reatus noster, f. fæm. aff. No. אַשְׁמָה; Rad. אָשַׁם reum fieri.
אַשְׁנָא odio habebo, אַשְׁנֶה iterabo, אַשְׁנֶה iterabo, אֶשְׁעֶה respiciam, fut. Kal, & Piel, 1. f. R. שָׁנָא, שָׁנָה, & שָׁעָה.
Note: the Hebrew forms in this column are read approximately; the vowel points and the superscript letters are doubtful.

page.notes: Right column continues beside the left. Several Hebrew forms have faint or doubled points and are uncertain; the superscript numerals (יו, ים, ם) are read as printed but may be misplaced.
